preconditions.expression: isinstance(A, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in A)
preconditions.description: A is a list of integers.
The length N of A is between 1 and 20,000 inclusive.
All elements in A are distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < len(A) for x in A)
preconditions.description: Each element of A is an integer within the range [0, N-1].

postconditions.expression: return_value == max((lambda start: len(set(chain_sequence(A, start))))(i) for i in range(len(A)))
postconditions.description: The return value is the maximum length of a sequence S[i] generated by starting at index i and following A[A[...]] until a duplicate would occur. The sequence S[i] contains distinct elements by definition of stopping before a duplicate.
